section2.title: 2. Description of Services
section2.body: Y7 provides vehicle transportation brokerage services. Y7 arranges for the transportation of motor vehicles by connecting Customers with licensed motor carriers in Y7's network. Y7 is a BROKER, not a motor carrier; Y7 does not operate vehicles or employ drivers. All transportation is performed by independent motor carriers. Y7 also provides supporting services including online quote requests, payment processing via third-party providers (Stripe), customer portal access, shipment tracking notifications, and customer support.
featuresList: Quote request submission via website, Telegram, or email
Shipment status notifications via email, SMS, and Telegram (where consented)
Customer portal access with order history and payment records
Dispute mediation between Customer and carrier

section13.body: Disputes between Customer and Y7 shall be resolved as follows:

Each party shall bear its own costs and attorneys' fees, except as may be awarded by the arbitrator.
